reasons: Ground line mismatch: the base strip (light 210,208,220 / mid 138,136,156 / outline 56,60,88) ends at kit row 60, but the neighbour houses (880/928/960/1296) end at row 62. In a street the centre floats 2px above the houses' foundations, which shows a seam at the ground.
Function is not legible at 1x: a star in a framed sign plus a gem dormer reads as a generic special or civic building, not a healing building.
Roof shingles, eave and trim shading are on par with the neighbours. The walls are flat cream like the neighbour walls, which is acceptable.
Grey stone corner pillars replace the neighbours' brown wood posts. This is acceptable as a civic marker but is the weakest style match.
3/4 view is OK: the roof top face and front wall are shown with no side walls. The dormer and sign show only top and front.
IP is OK: teal roof, no red roof, no cross, no text, no ball.
fixes: Move the whole kit down 2px (or redraw the bottom) so the base strip occupies rows 60-62 exactly like house 880. The foundation outline must land on row 62.
Swap the star emblem for a non-cross healing cue that reads at 1x, for example a heart with leaf sprigs, a herb or leaf on a white disc, or a bandage/mortar. Keep it non-red and non-cross.
Optionally give the stone pillars a 1px warm cap or base so they sit in the same material family as the wood posts.
